channel.title: Lawn & Landscape Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lawn & Landscape Magazine (lawnandlandscape.com)

item.title: Riverview Landscapes acquires Cleveland Brothers Landscaping in New York
item.description: Terry and Kevin will transition ownership of the business to Riverview while the rest of the team joins Riverview’s Albany branch.

item.title: Rockit Pest adds Green Solutions Lawn & Pest Control in Tampa
item.description: Green Solutions Lawn & Pest Control has been in operation since 2007.

item.title: Granum, Weathermatic enter multi-year strategic partnership
item.description: The partnership will include co-developed education and workforce training initiatives and expanded contractor resources across LMN, Greenius and Weathermatic channels.

item.title: The Harvest Group opens registration for virtual series on compensation strategies
item.description: The five-part series is led by Harvesters Steve Cesare and Alison Hoffman.

item.title: Green Lawn Fertilizing/Green Pest Solutions names Burke as HR director
item.description: A graduate of Shippensburg University, Padraic Burke earned his business degree with a focus in human resources.

item.title: Kioti Tractor rolls out Kioti Connect 2.0
item.description: Among other features, Kioti Connect 2.0 includes an intelligent assistant that translates technical machine data and alerts into guidance.

item.title: Lawn & Landscape announces keynote for Technology Conference
item.description: Theresa Payton, the CEO of Fortalice Solutions, will tell attendees about artificial intelligence and the future of AI in landscaping.

item.title: Schill Grounds Management acquires Begonia Brothers Services, Atlas Outdoor
item.description: These are Schill’s first acquisitions in Michigan.

item.title: Volvo CE makes Unicontrol's 3D machine control tech available on excavators
item.description: The Unicontrol3D system will be fully integrated with Volvo Active Control, providing one interface with one set of hardware.

item.title: Mammotion robotic lawn mowers to hit shelves at Walmart, Home Depot and Lowe’s
item.description: Building on its existing Walmart online e-commerce partnership, Mammotion products are now available in more than 700 Walmart stores across North America.
